## Latest continuation: direct closing attempts

**No universal closing implication was proved in this pass.** This continuation responds to the criticism that more families and interfaces can leave the central quantifier untouched. Three parallel attacks targeted actual universal target descent, the canonical escape boundary, and arbitrary reachable source/target carry states. Their exact failed inferences are recorded rather than counted as new progress theorems.

**Published head:** 23456d145df23ef2b412f61f7e49e38a222bc2b1
**Tree:** a5021583eaf69195b0163092d245bdc154d1680c

[Direct attempt and exact residuals](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/23456d145df23ef2b412f61f7e49e38a222bc2b1/research/global-synthesis-20261122/CENTRAL_CLOSURE_ATTEMPT.md) · [Actual source/target control](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/23456d145df23ef2b412f61f7e49e38a222bc2b1/reports/2026-11-22-global-synthesis/central-attempt-control.json)

### What was tested head on

- **Source-floor completion.** The global source-floor theorem does not force target return by exhaustion of the supplied certificate. The actual selected-domain pair target 319/source 296 has an eighteen-clock complete bounded-four source, whose entire future stays below 159. The target stays at least 319 through that clock and first descends at clock 21. The source arises from the actual last-crossing construction starting at 197.
- **Extremal source closure.** At a least-grade covering certificate, chosen with largest source at that grade, every lower-grade certified interval ends below the original target and no same-grade source enlargement is available. A universal closure still needs an actual target descent/merger at these queries. That event was not proved.
- **Canonical Green/five-boundary cancellation.** For the normalized strict Green operation A and canonical f=h/nu, Af=1-f. The D-factor controls the static five-commutator, but moving A through actual forward composition C leaves [C^k,A]f tending pointwise to F−1_E(1−F)A1. F is the entire canonical escape label. No cancellation of that term was obtained.
- **Arbitrary-word rational shadows.** No invariant controlling the unbounded exact exponent/debt pair on all reachable bounded-four histories was found. Discarding the history at source one reintroduces unrestricted target dynamics; this is not a proof that the retained history cannot help.

The note freezes PR177 8ef9..., PR180 ab397..., PR185 53f01..., PR175 728389..., and PR176 31c4... at their complete recorded SHAs. Independent mathematical readers checked the stated failed-step scopes and normalization. No new Lean module or axiom was added; previous compilation receipts remain pinned to their actual executions.

### Actual validation of this continuation

The exact 319/296 source and target paths, first descent, odd certificate, interval and last-crossing origin were replayed with integer arithmetic. All five required repository checks passed on this exact clean complete 485-file head; checkout identity was unchanged. Only the attempt note, its finite control record, and a README pointer were added or changed. No previously compiled proof source changed.

Publication-gate receipt SHA256: 159a02731ddc38257d176e1cec2395a5703b6153346f1e91a52399562dabd19b.

## 1. Effective classification over all independent block exponents

For every fixed finite list of nonempty shortcut parity blocks V1,...,Vr, the positive ordinary cycles represented by

`V1^e1 ... Vr^er, (e1,...,er) in Nat^r`

admit effective complete classification. The exponents vary independently; they need not lie on an affine one-parameter path.

Set Di=2^Li-3^si, K=max_i(|Di|+Ci), B=2*sum_i Ci. Unless a block fixes its incoming ordinary state, exact binary divisibility and actual forward heights give the common-source budget

`2^L <= [K*(x0+1)]^(2^r-1).`

A cyclic rotation and the explicitly specialized Matveev Corollary 2.3 yield

`L <= [2^(r+1)*(K+2B+2^33)]^2.`

Zero defects identify finitely many directly replayable block cycles; those are classified, not assumed trivial. Empty words, zero exponents, positivity, actual parity legality, and the whole cycle denominator are retained. The complete exponent realization relation is effectively semilinear.

This is a written theorem using an identified published logarithmic-form result. Four Lean statements check the ordinary integral budget. The classical Steiner–Simons–de Weger cycle-complexity mechanism is credited; no historical novelty claim is made for that mechanism.

### A complete two-parameter exclusion

For the odd-gap blocks

`P=(1,1,4,1,1,1,2), Q=(2),`

the packet excludes **every positive ordinary cycle P^a Q^b for all independent a,b>=1**, including cyclic rotations. PR185 established the diagonal a=b; this removes that restriction.

The proof excludes b>=a directly and uses one exact Farey interval to exclude every a>=16. Only 105 pairs remain: 20 have nonpositive denominators; the other 85 have nonzero remainders modulo the complete positive denominator. Exact rational series enclose both logarithms. An independent Python checker composes every finite parity word rather than reusing the generator's quotient formula.

Three further Lean statements check the arbitrary-denominator Farey obstruction and all 105 finite cases. The finite theorem uses kernel decide and depends on no axioms. The full real-logarithm coverage and Matveev application are written proofs, not claimed as a Lean formalization.

[Arithmetic proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/f464ddf2af6e340054673fdd6f5b28aba0310c10/research/global-synthesis-20261122/ARITHMETIC_CLOSURE.md) · [Integral budget](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/f464ddf2af6e340054673fdd6f5b28aba0310c10/research/global-synthesis-20261122/lean/IndependentBlockBudget.lean) · [Concrete Lean certificate](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/f464ddf2af6e340054673fdd6f5b28aba0310c10/research/global-synthesis-20261122/lean/IndependentPQCertificate.lean) · [Independent checker](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/f464ddf2af6e340054673fdd6f5b28aba0310c10/research/global-synthesis-20261122/certificates/independent_pq_verify.py) · [Review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/f464ddf2af6e340054673fdd6f5b28aba0310c10/reports/2026-11-22-global-synthesis/ARITHMETIC_REVIEW.md)

## 2. One escaping ordinary orbit forces a quantitative first moment

**Conditional on the precisely pinned uniform predecessor-population input PDU**, define m(n) as the least actual future odd value of an odd ternary unit n. One injective ordinary orbit gives disjoint off-spine basins whose least roots grow at most geometrically. Every original source in the selected jth basin has exactly m(n)=min(rj,tj), and therefore m(n)>=3*rj/64.

If c,C0 are the PDU constants and R=(64/3)*(t0+1), then for every X>=C0*R:

`X^-1 * sum_(n<=X) m(n) >= [3c/(64 log(3/2))] * log(X/(C0 R)),`

`sum_(n<=X) m(n)/n >= [3c/(128 log(3/2))] * log(X/(C0 R))^2.`

The sums run over the original odd unit sources. At each cutoff the proof counts only a finite family with a common onset; it does not exchange an infinite disjoint sum with a density limit. Fixed-truncation analogues are also proved.

Consequently, even a subsequence with sum m(n)/(X log X) tending to zero would exclude all escapes. This weakens the earlier bounded-first-moment target. The required upper estimate is still unproved, and cycles remain separate.

Two Lean statements formalize finite disjoint-basin accounting with unchanged source weights and all population premises explicit. The PDU analytic proof, infinite ordinary construction, and logarithmic optimization are not installed as axioms. The note also tests the newest canonical harmonic flow and identifies the missing minimum/height weight that its current moment bounds do not pay.

## 3. A complete-tail selector with explicit height and clock bounds

For every supplied complete odd unit certificate at q and every N>=q, the new Lean theorem produces a predecessor p and prefix W with

`N < p, 3*p < 16*N, length(W) <= C(N), sum(W) <= 4*C(N),`

where all gaps of W lie in {1,2,3,4} and the resulting complete certificate is literally `W ++ tail`. Here C(N) counts positive odd ternary units at most N.

The six-row inverse table is credited to PR177. The new proof uses strictly increasing first hitting times, pairwise distinct inverse vertices, and the first height crossing. Eleven public statements check exact ordinary clocks, the finite budget, and unchanged-tail composition.

The written continuation also classifies the entire cap-three inverse graph of

`q0=1+3^h*u, h>=1, u>0 even, u=2 mod3:`

it is the unique gap-two chain `qj=1+4^j*3^(h-j)*u`, ending at a nonunit leaf. The sources `q=(4^(1+2*3^h)-1)/3` supply fully certified examples at every depth. Thus universal cofinal cap-three literal-tail replacement is false even on a growing certified family. These tails have large gaps, so this does not refute a selective rule on the residual alphabet-four language.

## 4. Late composition: larger certified intervals with a smaller grade

The closing source refresh found four newer heads: PR183 at 68345f60a4f757acb42a69a4ac95910f8ce26163, PR180 at cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb, PR175 at 75e4c3be98db839646ffbb76fc0ac33649747c99, and PR182 at 9dacd610ba7735e89e2e29e4ab01795983317980.

**Parallel attribution:** PR183 independently proves the same broad independent-block-exponent classification. Its mathematical commit 84a76f0d81839494e17a0de5fea207ea96da5f87 has earlier recorded repository publication than our 2eb1006 checkpoint. The derivations used earlier frozen inputs. No priority claim is made; our complete independent-a,b P^aQ^b exclusion and exact certificate remain distinct in the inspected changes.

A new written composition combines the inherited exact gap-two trace with PR183's paid-padding grade. If a supplied source prefix has maximum gap four and contains a four, its retained root is q=1+3^h*v (h>=1, v positive even), and its initial even run is at most three, replace the prefix by h gap twos with initial even run three. The certified new source is 8*(1+4^h*v). Its inserted grades are seven and fours, while an eight disappears; the identical tail cancels.

Under the same IntervalHyp, this captures every actual positive endpoint up to 16*(1+4^h*v)+1. In particular, with a single first gap four:
- Initial even run two and q>1, q=1 mod 81: the entire original active interval is covered at target clock zero.
- Initial even run three and q>1, q=1 mod 729: the same whole-interval conclusion holds.

A complete alphabet-four example replaces source 127892 (clock 60) by source 151560 (clock 65), while strictly lowering the grade. Its interval ceiling 303121 exceeds the whole literal-cut ceiling 143889 and captures the residual target 255783. Positive source growth and clock growth are both retained; the proof uses the multiset grade.

This composition was independently reconstructed as written mathematics. Its exact complete certificates, grade comparison, target paths, whole literal-cut maximum, and sixteen parameter controls replay identically under normal and optimized Python. It is **not** included among the twenty compiled Lean statements and does not prove universal residual coverage.

## Full-theorem obligation still open

The arithmetic cutoff depends on the number and contents of the blocks; arbitrary cycles may have unbounded descriptions. The escape argument needs the stated upper bound on the actual minimum with its original source weights. A total successful lower-rank physical merger selector could address both instead, but the low-interval residual is still uncovered. None of these missing conclusions is asserted or assumed as a proved theorem.
